title: Record page and record drawer: the close button ✕ moves from the top right to the top left
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed by the seat on the maintainer's request, 2026-11-22 22:54Z: 「记录详情页的关闭按钮应该改到左上角」, with two screenshots (a contract record on the full page, and the same record in the drawer over the contract list; the ✕ at the top right is circled in both). Not claimed.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:ui`

## 维护者速读

- 问题：记录详情的关闭按钮 ✕ 在右上角，整页和列表上的侧滑面板都是。
- 要改成：✕ 放到左上角，在「↑ ↓ 第 N 条，共 M 条」前面。
- 要你做的：无。

## What happens

The record's top bar draws its frame controls at the far right of the navigation row on every face: in a drawer ⤢ then ✕, on the full page ✕ alone. Measured on main from the code, not live:

- `ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx` (the `RecordTopBar` docblock: "Right: the frame controls (`frame`: ⤢ in a drawer, then ✕ — at the far right on every face)"). This placement came from #27524 Target 7 and #35853 figure 40.
- Hosts: the page in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`; the drawer and split pane in `ui/packages/components/src/custom/navigation-overlay.tsx`, through `recordDrawerStack.tsx`.

## What should happen

On the full page and in the drawer (and the split or maximized pane, which share the bar), ✕ is the first control at the left of the navigation row, before whatever the host hands as `leading` and before ↑ ↓ and the counter. ⤢ stays at the right. Every way of closing works as today (✕, Escape, the view name that returns to the list).

The phone face (one-row bar, its own back control at the left) is out of scope: the screenshots are desktop. Say so in the PR if the phone bar needs a matching change.

## Done when

- ✕ is the leftmost control of the navigation row on the page and drawer faces; its accessible name and handler are unchanged.
- The `RecordTopBar` docblock states the new placement, and the existing top-bar tests that pin "✕ at the far right" are rewritten to pin the left.
- No new export, key or i18n string.

## Serial constraint

PR #36551 (card #36472) changes `navigation-overlay.tsx` and is landing; branch after it merges.

## Re-check

`grep -n "far right on every face" ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx`: a hit means the old placement is still documented.
